## 1. Gather the Essentials (30 seconds)

| Item | What to ask for / obtain | Why it matters |

| **Utilities & other fees** | Which utilities are included, who pays for what, any admin fees | Avoids hidden costs. |
| **Pet policy / smoking / sub‑letting rules** | Written confirmation of any restrictions | Keeps you compliant. |

**Tip:** Put all of the above into a single email titled “Sublet Confirmation – [Address] – Quick Summary” and send it to the current tenant (or the landlord if you have their contact). Ask them to reply with “Yes, I confirm the details below are correct.” That creates a written record instantly.
